title_short: Josh Feliciano · AYH · Something Bigger Than Me
headline: The only Soles4Souls employee in Denver says he always wanted this work, because it makes him part of something bigger than himself.
story: Josh is the warehouse coordinator, the only Soles4Souls employee in Denver. Asked if he is happy, he says yes: he always wanted this kind of work, and it lets him give back to people in need all over the world.

He runs on volunteers. Hundreds up to thousands of shoes come in every week. The sorted shoes go to places like the Dominican Republic, Guatemala and Haiti, where they help people start a business and get out of poverty.

His happiness is being part of something bigger than him. His message: try to be the best human you can be. Loops: L1 “Are you happy?” opens at 0:00 and closes at once on “I am happy.” L2 “Why?” opens on “I've always wanted to do this kind of work” and closes on “bigger than me”.

bite:1.why: The scale and why he needs hands.

bite:1.quote: I am the warehouse coordinator for Soles4Souls here in Denver, Colorado.
bite:1.why: Who he is, if the super is not enough.

bite:1.quote: a network of volunteers that help me pick up these shoes and bring them here to our facility so that we can sort through them.

bite:2.quote: So these shoes that were sorted today will most likely end up in places like the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Haiti, just to name a few.
bite:2.why: The places, in one clean take.

bite:2.quote: So a lot of the product we get through here are used shoes, and it helps our program called 4Opportunity, which help people in these lower income countries start a business, and get themselves out of poverty.
So the 4EveryKid program is a program geared towards kids experiencing homelessness here in America where they get a brand new pair of shoes.
So we want to make sure that they are pairs, we want to make sure that they still have life in them, and that our partners down in areas we serve have good usable shoes.

bite:3.quote: And I'm happy to be just a part of that.
And I feel like any little thing that I can do will make an impact, no matter how great it is.
So I do what I do because I know that it is going to benefit someone that is less fortunate somewhere in the world.

bite:4.quote: If I could say one thing to those who support us, it's a big thank you. We cannot do what we do without your help.
And I feel like any little thing that I can do will make an impact, no matter how great it is.
So I do what I do because I know that it is going to benefit someone that is less fortunate somewhere in the world.
bite:4.why: Ends on the world, like his message.
